unit_label: Section 10: Relativ-ganze Bereiche erster Art und ihre Integritätsbasis
title_de: Relativ-ganze Bereiche erster Art und ihre Integritätsbasis.
translation_source_policy: Translated directly from the audited German source slice. The English control slice was used only as a sanity witness for Hilbert Problem 14, integrality-basis, and relative-integrality vocabulary; this unit was not edited from another target-language draft.

technical_exclusions.disposition: Section 11 and later Paper 06 content; not included in this checkpoint.

segment_summaries.content: Section heading introduces first-kind relatively integral domains and their integrality basis.
segment_summaries.choices: Uses rod/rid rather than type/tip for German Art, because the phrase is a named class marker rather than an informal kind.

segment_summaries.content: Motivation from Section 9 relative algebraic integrality and Hilbert Problem 14; Definition VI of an integrality basis and finite integral domain.
segment_summaries.choices: Integritätsbasis becomes Ukrainian integralna baza, Russian integralnyi bazis, Interslavic integralna baza.

segment_summaries.content: Definition VII of first-kind relatively integral domains by the mapping domain condition; proof that the involution basis becomes an integrality basis.
segment_summaries.choices: Algebraisch ganz abhängt is rendered as integral over the indicated polynomials/domain, not as ordinary algebraic dependence.

segment_summaries.content: Criterion via Hilbert auxiliary theorem: rho algebraically independent polynomials control integrality in the domain and its mapping domain.
segment_summaries.choices: Hilfssatz is auxiliary theorem; mapping-domain terminology continues from Sections 3, 7, 8, and 9.

segment_summaries.content: Final italic characterization and footnote example for G22 under specialization x1=1.
segment_summaries.choices: The final statement preserves the Noether conclusion that the mapping domain itself becomes relatively integral under the hypothesis.
